name: Tagum City rice farm
persona: Illustrative smallholder rice farmer, Tagum City
place: Barangay Buclad, Tagum City, Davao del Norte (Davao Region)
story: Two rice crops a year (January-April and June-September) leave the field bare from late September to January, in a wet climate with no real dry season. A short legume such as mungbean or peanut could use that window. La Nina floods and heavy rain are the main weather risk here.

name: Central Iowa corn-soybean farm
persona: Illustrative mechanized corn-soybean farmer, Boone County
place: Rural Boone County, Iowa, west of Ames
story: The classic two-crop rotation, mechanized and rain-fed. Fields sit bare from the October harvest to the May planting, through frost and snowmelt. A cereal rye cover crop could hold the soil over winter. A strong contrast with the Philippines farm.
